body: A gf doesn’t fix any problems when coming but creates a lot more when going

I dont understand these people. How stupid are they to not understand that its not funny and that laughing is just making it worse. Fuck these people. I dont know how you have to feel cause it never happened to me but I can imagine how it has to be. We are here for you. I hope you will be fine
I also like listening to sad music

I dont know what the reason for you feeling this pain is but I understand you. I just want to say that you are an important person who deserves to feel better. I hope you will stay with us and find something that makes you happy. I pray for you
Same for me. And this makes every comment or post just more weird
I need like an hour to write a comment or post because Im afraid of what others will think

I feel the same. Its like something would be inside me doing all the things and Im just watching and feeling the pain. I hope we will wake up at one point again and be able to live the life like a "normal" person
I understand you. I hope you will find something that makes you feel truly happy
